XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine malfunction indicator light comes on, with properly running vehicle

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Oil pressure solenoid valve

  • Fault: The vehicle exhibits poor performance with significant power loss and the engine fault light illuminates. Restarting the vehicle temporarily restores normal operation.

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: P06DD (Engine oil pressure, malfunction – Wiring)

  • Cause: Faulty oil pressure solenoid valve

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the oil pressure solenoid valve and, if necessary, replace it.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: After replacement, it is not necessary to reprogram the system using diagnostic equipment. In this case, the component showed no abnormalities during a visual inspection. The solenoid valve is located near the heat exchanger.
